dash.lead: Plan, write, check and publish educational material — with every document verified against fixed rules before it leaves your desk.
dash.workflowIntro: Three stages, one document. Each stage hands a clean file to the next.
dash.step1Desc: Check a document against the fixed import contract and see exactly where it breaks.
dash.step2Desc: Automatically repair safe structural problems — glued numbers, broken headers — without touching the wording.
dash.step3Desc: Create courses, textbooks, teacher guides and IELTS materials from a structured plan.
dash.toolValidateDesc: Report every structural problem with its location and a suggested fix.
dash.toolRepairDesc: Fix structure only, then download a corrected .docx.
dash.toolGeneratorsDesc: Course design, assessment and content generators.
dash.p1Desc: The same document always produces the same result. Rules, not guesses.
dash.p2Desc: Documents are processed in memory and discarded as soon as the response is sent.
dash.p3Desc: Validation and repair use no AI at all. Generated drafts always pass human review.
dash.p4Desc: No accounts, no file history, nothing to leak.

validate.title: IELTS Document Validator
validate.lead: Checks a document exactly the way a fixed-rule importer reads it. Nothing is changed and nothing is stored.
validate.check1: Section headers stand alone on their own line
validate.check2: Every question number starts its own line
validate.check3: No missing, duplicated or out-of-order numbers
validate.check5: Heading lists use literal roman numerals
validate.check6: Answer key is complete and correctly placed
validate.emptyDesc: Results appear here, grouped by severity, with the exact line and a suggested fix.

result.label: Validation result
result.validDesc: Every header, question number and answer follows the import contract.
result.englishNote: Issue details are written in English, the language of the IELTS import contract.

repair.title: Format Repair
repair.lead: Repair structural formatting problems without changing the original wording.
repair.confHigh: Higher — fewer automatic changes, more items left for you to review.
repair.guaranteeDesc: Only line breaks are inserted and Word numbering is turned into text. If a fix would change a single character of the wording, the repair is rejected.
repair.rejectedDesc: The repair would have changed the document's wording, so nothing was produced.
repair.notExported: No file was produced. Resolve the items below and run the repair again.
repair.emptyDesc: You'll get a summary, a corrected .docx and a list of anything that needs your decision.

gen.title: Generators
gen.lead: Every generator follows the same pattern: a structured plan, an AI draft, deterministic checks, and human approval.
gen.aiOff: AI generation is not enabled on this website yet. Generators run from the command line until an AI provider key is configured on the server.
gen.aiOn: An AI provider is configured on this server.
gen.catCourseDesc: From a teaching idea to a sequenced course and its books.
gen.catAssessmentDesc: Complete practice materials for all four modules.
gen.catContentDesc: Building blocks used inside books and courses.
gen.curriculumDesc: Modules, lessons and measurable objectives that fit your schedule.
gen.graphDesc: Concepts and prerequisites, checked so nothing is taught too early.
gen.studentBookDesc: Chapters with explanations, worked examples and practice.

about.title: Educational material that parsers can trust.
about.lead: Osamu Dazai is an educational publishing engine. It plans, writes and checks teaching material — and refuses to publish anything that fails its rules.
about.whyBody: Teaching documents are increasingly read by machines before they are read by students: exam platforms, learning systems and importers that follow fixed rules. A single glued question number can break an entire test. Osamu Dazai treats structure as seriously as content.
about.how1: A structured plan fixes what must be produced — objectives, sequence, question types.
about.how2: Drafts are written to that plan, by a person or by an AI model.
about.how3: Deterministic checks verify every draft. Failures are sent back; nothing unchecked is used.
about.how4: A teacher or editor reviews and approves before anything is published.
about.integrityBody: Repairs change structure, never wording. Every repair is recorded with its position and confidence, and the original and repaired texts are compared character by character before a file is produced.
about.privacyBody: Uploaded files are processed in memory to produce the report and corrected document, then discarded. There are no accounts and nothing is stored on the server.
about.principle1: Rules before models: AI drafts, code decides.
about.principle3: Built for English, Uzbek and Russian from the start.
about.principle4: Open formats: Word, HTML, PDF, Markdown and JSON.

footer.privacy: Files are processed in memory and never stored.
